title: K01 magnetic actuator FEMM screening → final release plan

assembly_basis.interpretation: The C2R1 verification assembly is already a full assembly clone for current geometry review. It is not the final production assembly because C2R1 has not been atomically promoted and P006/P015/B001 release items remain.

screening_can_start_when: P006 service candidate is built/read back or explicitly shown to be magnetically irrelevant to the axisymmetric screen
current B001 screening magnet geometry/material assumptions are recorded
final_release_requires: P015 production material, winding, turns, conductor data and current limit
actual B001 supplier magnet dimensions/tolerances and Br(T)/temperature data
outputs: force vs position at 0/5/10 mm and refined sweep
force vs current including 1.0 A nominal and 1.25 A reserve
minimum KF over released position/tolerance/temperature envelope
sensitivity to magnet Br/dimensions, air gaps and coil position
acceptance_link: Existing actuator screening requires KFmin ≥ 0.930895 N/A at nominal 1 A; final criterion remains subject to the controlled release package.
